title: Law to study barriers to special education by income and language
summary: This bill would require the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, working with the Department of Education, to study how language access needs, household income and geographic location affect students' access to special education programs and services. The study must examine disparities by borough, zip code and school district, and identify barriers and recommendations to improve equitable access. A report with findings and recommendations would be due within 6 months of the law taking effect.
